user.title: Connect the server
user.description: Set up the PenguinPVDash server first. Then enter its address, device ID and API key here. Clicking **Next** tests the connection without storing measurement data.

data.output_unit: Unit of the live power sensors

data_description.instance_name: A descriptive name such as “Home PV” or “Test server”.
data_description.server_url: Only the base address is required, for example `http://10.10.4.122:8092`. `/api/ingest.php` is added automatically. A full ingest URL is also accepted.
data_description.api_key: Must match the API key configured on the server for this device ID.
data_description.device_id: For example `home` or `home2`. It must match the device ID configured on the server.
data_description.interval: How often Home Assistant sends current values. One minute is recommended.
data_description.output_unit: Unit used by the live power sensors selected later: W or kW.

sensors.title: Assign sensors
sensors.description: The server at `{server}` responded (version {version}). Now assign the sensors used for energy flow, battery and daily history.

data_description.pv_entity: Total current PV output. Combine all PV systems first when more than one is installed.
data_description.consumption_entity: Total current whole-home consumption. For an additional balcony PV system, use a Home Assistant sensor that already includes it.
data_description.feedin_entity: Current power exported to the public grid.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Current power imported from the public grid.
data_description.batt_soc_entity: Current battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.batt_charge_entity: Current positive power used to charge the battery.
data_description.batt_discharge_entity: Current positive power delivered by the battery.
data_description.pv_total_kwh_entity: Total PV energy generated during the current day.
data_description.consumption_total_kwh_entity: Total whole-home consumption during the current day.
data_description.feedin_total_kwh_entity: Energy exported to the public grid during the current day.
data_description.grid_import_total_kwh_entity: Energy imported from the public grid during the current day.
data_description.batt_in_total_kwh_entity: Energy charged into the battery during the current day.
data_description.batt_out_total_kwh_entity: Energy discharged from the battery during the current day.

error.invalid_url: The server address is invalid. Use an IP address or an HTTP/HTTPS URL.
error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached. Check the address, port, firewall and Docker container.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the device ID or API key.
error.invalid_server: No compatible PenguinPVDash server was found at this address.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while testing the server.

init.title: Edit PenguinPVDash instance
init.description: Change the server connection, transmission interval and sensor mapping. When the server address, device ID or API key changes, Home Assistant automatically tests the connection before saving. Sensor-only changes can still be saved while the external server is temporarily offline.

data.output_unit: Unit of the live power sensors

data_description.instance_name: A descriptive name such as “Home PV” or “Test server”.
data_description.server_url: Only the base address is required. `/api/ingest.php` is added automatically.
data_description.api_key: Must match the API key configured on the server.
data_description.device_id: Must match the device ID configured on the server.
data_description.output_unit: Unit used by all current power sensors: W or kW.
data_description.batt_soc_entity: Battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.pv_total_kwh_entity: PV generation during the current day.
data_description.consumption_total_kwh_entity: Whole-home consumption during the current day.
data_description.feedin_total_kwh_entity: Grid export during the current day.
data_description.grid_import_total_kwh_entity: Grid import during the current day.
data_description.batt_in_total_kwh_entity: Battery energy charged during the current day.
data_description.batt_out_total_kwh_entity: Battery energy discharged during the current day.

error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached. The changes were not saved.
error.invalid_auth: The device ID or API key was rejected. The changes were not saved.
error.invalid_server: No compatible PenguinPVDash server was found at this address.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while testing the server.
